'''Selean''' was a town in [[Cairhien]]. It was located at the western end of the [[Jangai Pass]], in the [[Spine of the World]].

==Activities==
When [[Couladin]] and the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]] pass through Selean, they decimate the town.{{ref/book|5|24}} [[Rand al'Thor]], when he passes through the devastated town of [[Taien]], wonders if Selean would suffer the same fate.{{ref/book|5|20}} He finds out later that it did.{{ref/book|5|23}} It is unknown if the [[Cairhienin]] are going to rebuild the town.
